stories.head: Bloomreach Acquires AEO Leader AthenaHQ to Link AI Visibility to Revenue
stories.plain: Bloomreach bought AthenaHQ, a platform that helps brands show up inside AI-generated answers. The deal signals that answer engine optimization (AEO) is moving from an experiment into a core capability that major engagement platforms are willing to pay for — and that proving revenue impact from AI search is now a competitive priority.

stories.head: Twilio Launches Hallucination Detection and Task-Completion Scoring for AI Agents
stories.plain: Twilio's new Conversation Intelligence operators can flag when an AI agent makes things up and score whether it actually finished the job. These are runtime governance controls baked into a major CEP, which matters because brands deploying voice and chat agents have had almost no automated safety net until now.

stories.head: When AI Agents Evaluate B2B Vendors, Clear Evidence Beats Features
stories.plain: As AI agents increasingly do the first round of vendor research for B2B buyers, the article explains that structured, credible product information — not just feature lists — determines whether a vendor even enters consideration. This reframes content strategy: you are now writing for an agent audience, not just a human one.

stories.head: Amperity's Pér Agent Automates CDP Insight, Creative Pull, and A/B Test Setup in One Demo
stories.plain: A live walkthrough shows Amperity's AI agent Pér spotting a Gen Z retention gap, fetching creative assets from Salesforce, configuring a holdout group, and drafting a campaign — all without manual handoffs. It is a concrete example of agentic decisioning layered on top of a CDP, making the concept tangible for buyers.

stories.head: Revefi Launches Closed-Loop AI FinOps to Enforce Enterprise AI Budgets at Runtime
stories.plain: Revefi's new Auto Policy tool turns AI spending budgets into hard guardrails enforced in real time across every LLM, agent, and AI app a company runs. For marketing teams scaling agentic campaigns, this kind of spend control is becoming a governance requirement before procurement will approve broad deployment.

stories.head: Bloomreach Acquires AEO Platform AthenaHQ to Link AI Visibility to Revenue
stories.plain: Bloomreach bought AthenaHQ, a specialist in answer engine optimization, to help brands show up inside AI-generated answers and tie that visibility to actual sales. This is a significant acquisition because it signals that GEO is becoming a core martech capability, not a side experiment — and that platforms are racing to own the measurement layer connecting AI discovery to revenue.

stories.head: Twilio Launches Hallucination Detection and Task Completion Scoring for AI Agents
stories.plain: Twilio released two new Conversation Intelligence operators in public beta that flag when an AI agent says something false and score whether it actually finished the task. These are foundational governance controls for agentic customer interactions, giving enterprises a way to audit AI agent behavior in live conversations — a gap that has blocked many production deployments.

stories.head: When AI Agents Evaluate B2B Vendors, What Earns Consideration?
stories.plain: As AI agents increasingly shortlist B2B vendors on behalf of buyers, the article argues that clear, structured product information and third-party evidence now matter more than feature lists. This reframes the go-to-market challenge: marketers must optimize content for machine readers making purchase recommendations, not just human browsers scanning a website.

stories.head: Amperity Pér Demo: AI Agent Finds Retention Gap, Pulls Creative, and Drafts Campaign
stories.plain: A live walkthrough shows Amperity's AI agent Pér identifying a Gen Z retention problem in the CDP, retrieving creative assets from Salesforce, configuring a holdout and A/B test, and drafting the campaign — all in one flow. It is a rare concrete demonstration of agentic decisioning operating directly on a customer data platform, making the abstract concept tangible for buyers.

stories.head: Revefi Launches Closed-Loop AI FinOps to Enforce Enterprise AI Spend at Runtime
stories.plain: Revefi's new product converts approved AI budgets into hard guardrails enforced in real time through a gateway that covers every LLM, agent, and AI app in the enterprise. As agentic systems multiply, runtime cost enforcement becomes a governance requirement — this is one of the first products to close the loop between budgeting and actual AI usage.

month.skicker: 30-day synthesis · the shape underneath the feed

themes.head: AI Agents Are the New Buyer, Gatekeeper & Channel
body: When an AI agent does the shopping — comparing vendors, filtering options, placing orders — the brand's traditional pitch to a human buyer is bypassed entirely. What earns consideration is now structured data, verified credentials, and machine-readable trust signals, not compelling copy or a salesperson's relationship.

This is not a future scenario: ReachAgents already positions a personal agent as the starting point for ad participation, and MarTech analysis confirms agents are actively evaluating B2B vendors today. Marketers who ignore agent-readiness are effectively invisible in a growing share of the purchase funnel.
ev: MarTech · AI agents evaluate B2B vendors
Agile Brand · Delivery promise becomes the pitch

themes.head: AI Visibility & AEO Replaces SEO as Brand Discovery Layer
body: Bloomreach's acquisition of AthenaHQ — the leading Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) platform — signals that being found by AI answer engines is now a revenue-critical discipline, not an experimental side project. The deal explicitly frames AI visibility as something that must convert to measurable revenue, not just impressions.

This mirrors the early SEO land-grab: the brands that figure out how to surface correctly inside ChatGPT, Perplexity, and similar interfaces will compound an advantage that latecomers will find expensive to close. Brand reputation management in the AI era is no longer about review sites — it is about what the model says when asked.
ev: MarTech · Protect brand reputation in AI era

themes.head: Agent Governance & Measurement Lags Dangerously Behind Deployment
body: Marketers are shipping AI agents faster than they can instrument them: there is no standard metric for whether an agent completed its task correctly, let alone whether it hallucinated. Twilio's new hallucination-detection and task-completion scoring tools exist precisely because that gap is now a liability, not a roadmap item.

Revefi's closed-loop AI FinOps launch and the broader ops-readiness conversation confirm that the governance layer — budgets, guardrails, measurement, human review — is the missing infrastructure under most agent deployments. Marketing ops teams that build this scaffolding now will own the function's credibility when agents inevitably make costly mistakes.
ev: MarTech · Deploying agents faster than measuring them

themes.head: Brand Process Must Be Codified Before Agents Write
body: AI agents can produce content at scale, but they reproduce whatever brand logic is encoded — or fail when none is. The prerequisite is not a better model; it is documented, structured brand process that the agent can reference: voice guidelines, approval workflows, compliance rules, and audience definitions stored in a machine-readable form.

Tools like Postalytics Audience Builder 2.0 (build direct-mail lists by asking in plain language) and illumin's Ask Lu (from insight to ad activation via conversation) show the direction: natural-language interfaces are wrapping structured data pipelines, not replacing the need for clean, governed data underneath.
ev: MarTech · Brand process must live somewhere (Optimizely)

themes.head: Attribution & CAC Economics Need Fundamental Rethinking
body: Several threads converged this month on a single uncomfortable truth: the metrics marketers optimise — cheap CAC, last-touch attribution, channel-level ROAS — are increasingly disconnected from actual business outcomes in an AI-mediated media landscape. Combining Marketing Mix Modelling with post-purchase surveys is now being proposed as a more honest proxy for causality.

The cross-channel measurement framework piece and the CAC-vs-growth analysis both argue that AI-first media shuffles credit in ways that legacy attribution cannot see. Teams that chase the cheapest acquisition cost often buy low-quality cohorts; the fix requires longer measurement windows, blended models, and willingness to accept ambiguity rather than false precision.
ev: MarTech · Cheap CAC can be expensive growth
MarTech · MMM with post-purchase survey attribution

month.takeaway: Every theme this month points to the same gap: the operational infrastructure — governance, measurement, codified brand process, and agent-readable data — is not keeping pace with the speed at which AI is being dropped into customer-facing decisions, and that gap is where competitive advantage will be won or lost.
